# DevTools

## Purpose
Developer toggles for testing new systems on a device: named on/off switches kept in PlayerPrefs, read by the Commands that choose between an old and a new behaviour, and a hidden panel to flip them.

## Concepts
dev tools, debug panel, developer toggles, feature flags, IDevToolsService, CD_DevTools
